tickets.title: US001: 4-Year Planning Mode
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to create a 4-year academic roadmap in "Planning Mode" without checking live seat availability, so that I can map out my entire degree path regardless of current class capacities.

Acceptance Criteria:

1. Pass/Fail: The system allows students to add courses to future semesters (beyond the current/next active one).

2. Pass/Fail: The system evaluates prerequisite logic but does NOT block the addition based on live database seat limits for future terms.
